uncited: Fixes scale-aliasing via 3D smoothing + 2D Mip filter.
Replaces 3D ellipsoids with oriented disks for better surface reconstruction.
Uses voxel anchors + tiny MLP for compression and far-view extrapolation.
Provides Level-of-Detail (LoD) from city-scale to centimeter close-ups.
- **Time Complexity**: Rendering is $O(N)$ where $N$ is the number of Gaussians.
The optimization parameters described here are based on the original implementation and its refinements.
